calls.summary: The team discussed improving dashboard filters for clarity and user flexibility, emphasizing the need to balance global and block-level filters while addressing user confusion about their scope. They introduced a new date range UI inspired by Google Analytics, aimed at enhancing analysis capabilities. Performance problems were noted, particularly with the app's initial loading times and high RAM usage due to bulk loading strategies. Development workflow challenges were highlighted, with delays due to code review backlogs and team member absences. The team is committed to evolving the dashboard design to be more user-friendly, ensuring the interface supports complex filtering and comparisons while avoiding overwhelming users with irrelevant options.
calls.keywords: Filters, dashboard, Google Analytics, date picker, UI/UX, performance
